title: Embossed region from a circle
description: A 16.5 x 16 mm circle in the middle of the square converted to an embossed region (shape.emboss / Convert from Outline). PE-DESIGN 11.50 drops every needle point inside and leaves the fill's rows whole across it, up to 14.3 mm (within 6 mm of the centre 13 needle points per cm2, the under sewing's, against 126 without it); OpenStitch keeps whole stitches up to 14.5 mm from where a row enters and sews the rest last (11 per cm2 there).

evidence.note: PE-DESIGN 11.50 round-10 capture 471-embossed-region-circle.pes (SHA-256 9c291dff6fa3607bb7e736636033b0ce61b7095ec9dfbd5bb56f326f26d02fc5, 3191 stitches; the owner's, not in the repository until PES 0110 import reads a shape that carries a stamp), measured for #471

measurements.evidence: 3,369 stitches at #471: 63 fewer than the plain square (PE-DESIGN 60 fewer)
the rows cross the raised circle in whole stitches of up to 14.5 mm (PE-DESIGN 14.3 mm)
